summary: W6 structural closure and explainable result handoff. Implement endpoint closure, complete non-cascading View closure, and single first-inclusion provenance so Graph RAG responses are coherent, traceable, and understandable by downstream consumers.
notes: Selected viewpoint: Application Usage Viewpoint. Concern: returned Graph RAG content must be structurally complete and explainable to consuming Agents. Purpose: designing, deciding, and intent-to-implementation handoff preparation. The touched view grag-integrity-explainability remains an Application Usage Viewpoint instance because it shows how query-service application behavior turns a W5-selected range into coherent consumer-readable context.

Global approval evidence: the orchestrating W6 request explicitly approved structural closure and explainable result scope, named concepts grag-endpoint-closure, grag-view-closure, grag-provenance, and grag-coherent-context, required DT-13/DT-14/DT-15 mapping, requested handoff production, and requested an IntentDesign stage commit. The handoff schema does not permit an approvedByHuman field, so approval is recorded in schema-compliant notes and acceptanceApproval.* graph attributes.

Coverage matrix: grag-endpoint-closure functionalPoint.DT-13-endpoint-closure -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-DT-13. Control point: trigger a relationship seed whose endpoint text is not a semantic match. Observation point: relationship output includes both canonical endpoint Elements from the same graph version, and invalid/missing endpoints are reported rather than hidden.

Coverage matrix: grag-view-closure functionalPoint.DT-14-complete-view-closure -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-DT-14. Control point: query a View that shares members with other Views. Observation point: the matched View returns complete metadata, members, in-View relationships, and endpoints without cascading to overlapping Views by shared membership alone.

Coverage matrix: grag-provenance functionalPoint.DT-15-first-inclusion-provenance -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-DT-15. Control point: run an approved query exercising semantic-seed, relationship-endpoint, purpose-policy, and complete-View inclusion paths. Observation point: every returned object has exactly one stable firstInclusionReason; later matches are supplementary only and cannot overwrite it.

Outcome mapping: grag-coherent-context is the W6 observable outcome realized by endpoint closure, complete View closure, and provenance. It is intentionally not listed as an implementation target because its DT-13/DT-14/DT-15 acceptance evidence is mounted on the three exact implementation functions.

Dependency context: W6 starts after W5 purpose closure. grag-purpose-closure carries deliveryStatus=delivered and W5 delivery evidence; W6 elements remain not_delivered until downstream implementation passes their mounted DT-13, DT-14, and DT-15 entrypoints. No deliveryStatus attribute was created, changed, or inferred by Intent Design.

Release gate: relations must include both endpoints; matched Views must be complete and non-cascading; each returned object must have exactly one first-inclusion reason plus optional supplementary reasons; all returned objects must remain tied to consistent canonical graph/version evidence.

Scope boundary: W6 completes and explains the W5-selected result range. It does not change W4 seed discovery, W5 purpose-policy selection, graph-tidy full-snapshot bypass, W7 quality scoring, DT-18/DT-19 evidence, or capacity governance.

Downstream implementation should preserve same-element entrypoints already mounted in the intent graph: tests/explicit/entries/runRelationshipEndpointClosure.js, tests/explicit/entries/runCompleteViewClosure.js, and tests/explicit/entries/runFirstInclusionProvenance.js.
